mass_player_id.label: [%key:common::config_entries::mass_player_id::label%]
mass_player_id.description: The Music Assistant player this receiver plays casts through. Set to 'Auto' to automatically select a currently playing player, or the first available player if none is playing.

options.__auto__: Auto (playing player, otherwise the first available)

receiver_name.label: Receiver Name
receiver_name.description: How should this receiver be named in the YouTube/YouTube Music app's Cast device list?

cast_status.label: Cast Status
cast_status.description: Devices currently casting to this receiver and the player they play on. Reopen this page to refresh.

pairing_code_youtube.label: YouTube Pairing Code
pairing_code_youtube.description: Only needed if auto-discovery doesn't find this receiver in the app's Cast picker - enter this in Settings > Link with TV code.

pairing_code_youtube_music.label: YouTube Music Pairing Code
pairing_code_youtube_music.description: Only needed if auto-discovery doesn't find this receiver in the app's Cast picker - enter this in Settings > Link with TV code.

user.title: Configure YouTube Music Cast Receiver
user.description: Choose the player that receives casts and the name advertised in the YouTube/YouTube Music apps.

manifest.description: Cast music from the YouTube Music app to a Music Assistant player. Only music is supported: playback goes through the YouTube Music provider, so regular YouTube videos (vlogs, podcasts, talks) can't be played. Music videos cast from the YouTube app do work.
